header.role: Computer science student at LMU, 5th semester

about.title: About
about.text: Originally from Uzbekistan, I'm a computer science student at LMU Munich, currently in my 5th semester. I work as a research assistant, building Python-based data pipelines, and enjoy building side projects with React and TypeScript.

dataResearch.title: GitHub Data Research
dataResearch.description: A Python pipeline built for a research project studying how AI tools affect developer productivity, collecting and organizing GitHub user and repository data (contributor activity, commit/issue details, and dependency graphs) via the GitHub API, with a custom algorithm to manage rate limits.

danceData.title: Dance Data Analysis
danceData.description: Statistical analysis of dance competition scoring, porting fixed-effects regression models from Stata to Python to study how scoring bias and partner effects shape competition outcomes

probly.title: Probly
probly.description: Contributed to and wrote tests for a Python package for uncertainty quantification in machine learning, transforming standard neural networks into uncertainty-aware models, sampling predictive distributions, and quantifying  uncertainty for tasks like out-of-distribution detection. Worked on model calibration and test coverage as part of a team.

manage.title: Manage
manage.description: An earlier JavaScript-based project built with HTML and CSS.

bank.title: Bank
bank.description: An interactive JS-based web project simulating a banking system's interface, built with HTML and Tailwind CSS.
